fns.desc: tncc_read_config's line-scan while(*line_end!='\n' && *line_end!='\r' && line_end<end) dereferences *line_end before the bounds check runs (wrong && order); 1-byte OOB read at buffer end when the last config line has no trailing newline

Following that scan, '*line_end = NUL' writes one byte past config[config_len-1] (os_readfile() allocates exactly config_len bytes, no NUL terminator) when the TNC config file's final line lacks a trailing newline/CR
